title: 10-Session Baseball Training Package in Long Beach & OC | MBM
description: Ten 60-minute 1-on-1 baseball sessions with Coach Myles at about 10% off the single-session rate — a consistent development plan, video breakdown included. Long Beach & Orange County.
lead: The 10-Session Package is where real development happens. Ten 60-minute sessions at a lower per-session rate, tied together by one consistent plan instead of ten disconnected lessons — so each session builds on the last.
body: Skill development is cumulative. With ten sessions mapped out, Coach Myles can sequence the work the right way: build the foundation first, layer on complexity, and revisit and reinforce as your player grows. That continuity is the single biggest reason players on a package improve faster than players booking one-offs.

The package includes a video breakdown so progress is visible, flexible scheduling that works around your season and school calendar, and a development plan your player and family can actually follow. You're not just buying ten lessons — you're buying a coached arc of improvement.

It's the right fit for committed players who train year-round or want a focused block heading into a season. If your player is ready for the deepest level of investment — 30 sessions, priority scheduling, and game-film review — the Elite Season Program is the step up.
bestFor: Families who want a structured plan, not one-off lessons
Anyone preparing for a season or tryouts over several weeks

faq.q: How much do I save versus single sessions?
faq.a: The package brings the per-session rate down versus booking single 60-minute sessions, and adds a video breakdown and a development plan across the ten sessions.

faq.q: How long do I have to use the sessions?
faq.a: Scheduling is flexible and works around your season and school calendar — Coach Myles will set a cadence that fits your player. Ask about timing when you book.

faq.q: What's the difference from the Elite Season Program?
faq.a: The Elite Program is a full-season commitment — 30 sessions with priority scheduling, game-film review, and a season-long plan at the best per-session value.
